title: Explainer Videos for Product Launches (blog explainer)

brief.story: A clear explainer of the post.

slides.title: Explainer Videos for Product Launches
slides.notes: Launch week is noisy, and people decide in seconds. A short launch video gives everyone the same clear story, and your deck already holds most of it.

slides.title: A launch video explains once, for everyone
bullets: It works without you in the room
It travels: product page, email, social, press kit
slides.notes: Write the explanation carefully once, and it keeps working. A prospect can watch at 10pm, and a partner can forward it to their boss.

slides.title: Follow five beats, problem to next step
bullets: How it works, in two or three steps
slides.notes: Start with a problem viewers recognise, like chasing late invoices on Friday afternoons. Then show the product, how it works, the proof, and where to go next.

slides.title: Keep it shorter than you think
bullets: Product page and email: one to two minutes
Social clips: one or two slides, captioned
Thirty slides? Six to ten will do
slides.notes: The job is to make someone want the next step, not to document every feature. Cut anything that is merely nice to know.

slides.title: Build it from your existing launch deck
slides.notes: Swap labels for claims. Reminders becomes: reminders go out on your schedule, not when you remember. Then add real screenshots and captions.

slides.title: From launch deck to launch video
bullets: On Pro, a.i. directs each animated scene
Edit the deck when the product changes
slides.notes: On Pro, a.i. directs your launch deck into an animated explainer, so the reveal feels produced. Try Basic first at powerpoint2vid.com.
